6719-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
6719-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1793-6249-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Harvester of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1309-1987-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1309-1987-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1987-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

104-3263-4186-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3263-4186-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-3836-5078-5957.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1744-4836-6567.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Dragonhawk.
When the Dragonhawk tokens enter the battlefield, they each trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling a number of cards from the top of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your end step, each Dragonhawk token triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent for each card exiled by the Dragonhawk tokens that were not played.
1744-4836-6567.notes: Assuming you control no other creatures with power 4 or greater, this combo can deal up to 60 damage to each opponent. This is reduced by 2 for each card you play that is exiled. For every additional creature you control with power 4 or greater, this combo deals up to an additional 10 damage per creature to each opponent.

2104-4428-7722.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Thassa.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

4499-6595-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with The Third Doctor

1409-5184-5422.description:
Activate The Third Doctor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When The Third Doctor enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and The Third Doctor.
Resolve the The Third Doctor trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

729-1170-1329-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Tormod's Crypt.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Oak Guardian.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3944-5220-6273-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
3944-5220-6273-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

856-3967-5220-6900.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-3967-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-3967-5220-6900.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

5256-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

186-2060-5140-6774.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
186-2060-5140-6774.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

224-1772-5621-6763.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3951-5703-5744.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
1270-3951-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating three tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-1445-4871-6351.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
413-1445-4871-6351.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1940-2034-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1940-2034-6249--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the persist creature dies, it and Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

1193-3663-4772.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating two token copies of Three Blind Mice.
The Three Blind Mice tokens enter the battlefield with two lore counters on them due to Doubling Season, triggering their first and second chapter abilities.
Resolve the first Three Blind Mice triggers, creating four 1/1 Mouse creature tokens.
Resolve the next Three Blind Mice trigger, creating two token copies of a Three Blind Mice token.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite Three Blind Mice triggers, you may use them to copy any token(s) you control.

1308-4508-5880-5929.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

501-1698-3260-3540.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
501-1698-3260-3540.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
501-1698-3260-3540.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

2034-2281-6125.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Fiendish Panda.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fiendish Panda, adding {C}{C}.
When Fiendish Panda dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Fiendish Panda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fiendish Panda trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1285-1749-1883-2182-4836.description:
Cast Replication Technique by paying {4}{U}, creating a token copy of Dark Depths.
Activate Mishra's Groundbreaker by tapping and sacrificing it, causing Dark Depths to become a creature.
Activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from the Dark Depths token.
The Dark Depths token triggers, causing you to not sacrifice it due to The Master.
Step 4 repeats infinitely, creating a mandatory infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.

1684-2178-2292-2757.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
You control at least one basic Mountain.
1684-2178-2292-2757.description:
Activate a basic Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it, creating a 3/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Elemental, untapping the Mountain.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Elemental.
When the Elemental dies, Rakka Mar triggers, untapping Rakka Mar.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

559-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Frontline Strategist, adding {W}.
When Frontline Strategist dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Frontline Strategist from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Frontline Strategist's morph ability by paying {W}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1545-2469-3260-4078.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought by paying {1}.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters the battlefield, it and Trostani trigger.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Dreadnought's toughness.
Resolve the Phyrexian Dreadnought trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

116-283-2500.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Mirage Mirror do not have summoning sickness.
116-283-2500.description:
Activate any mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Kiora's Follower until end of turn.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting the mana-producing permanent.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability, targeting Mirage Mirror.
Resolve both abilities, untapping the permanent and Mirage Mirror.
Activate Mirage Mirror by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate any mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 3.

372-2719-4284.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
372-2719-4284.description:
Cast Sakashima either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} and commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Sakashima enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Sakashima leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Clone returns from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Sakashima.
When Clone enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sakashima until Clone leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Sakashima leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Clone until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Clone leaves the battlefield, Sakashima returns to the battlefield from exile as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

2043-2648-4659.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Phyrexian Triniform that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Phyrexian Triniform, adding {C}{C}.
When Phyrexian Triniform dies, it triggers, creating three 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Golems, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Urza to make infinite copies of any artifacts you control.

1530-1671-3293.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
1530-1671-3293.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Play Simic Growth Chamber from your hand.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Emeria Shepherd.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

101-1193-4095.notablePrerequisites: There are permanents on the battlefield that enter the battlefield untapped and produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
101-1193-4095.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting anything but Vampire Charmseeker.
In response, cast Radiate by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating copies of Mythos of Illuna that target each permanent besides the original target.
Resolve all copies of Mythos of Illuna besides the original, creating token copies of each permanent besides the original target.
The token copy of Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Radiate from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the token lands or other mana-producing permanents created in step 3 by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2, doubling the number of copies created in step 3 each repetition.
